en: [[Humans]] first [[used]] [[coins]] in the 5th or 6th century BC, which were shaped like small metal disks.
me: which were shaped like small metal disks.
easy: first ... in the 5th or 6th century BC
which were shaped like small metal disks
작은 금속 원반 모양으로 만들어진(shape 모양을 만들다).
요약: 사람들은 기원전 5~6세기에 원반 모양 동전을 처음 썼다.
notes: which 뒤 동사는 선행사에 맞춘다: 복수 coins → was(X) were
be p.p. + like: were shaped like ~ = ~ 모양으로 만들어졌다 (수동)

en: [[I]] [[will feel]] [[motivated]] when I receive encouraging words from my friends, who always support me generously.
me: when I receive encouraging words from my friends,
easy: 요약: 나를 늘 응원하는 친구들의 격려가 힘이 된다.
notes: 동사를 꾸미는 말은 부사: support(응원하다)를 꾸미니까 generous(X) → generously(아낌없이). 형용사는 명사를 꾸민다
who 뒤 동사는 friends(복수)에 맞춰 support — 복수 동사

en: When Columbus arrived in America, [[he]] [[discovered]] [[that people were already living there]], and this fact surprised the crew who was traveling with him.
me: that people were already living there,
and this fact surprised the crew who was traveling with him.
easy: that people were already living there
그곳에 이미 사람들이 살고 있다는 것을(live 살다).
요약: 이미 사람이 살고 있어서 선원들이 놀랐다.
notes: 관계대명사절에는 진짜 동사가 필요하다. traveling만으로는 동사가 못 된다 → was traveling(be + -ing)
be + -ing = ~하고 있는 중이다(진행). 예: He was running.

en: Once the plane lands, [[I]] [[will check]] [[my phone]] for messages that were sent to me during the flight.
me: for messages that were sent to me during the flight.
easy: that were sent to me during the flight
요약: 비행기에서 내리면 그동안 온 메시지부터 확인하겠다.
notes: 메시지는 '보내지는' 것 → 수동태 be p.p.: sent(X) → were sent (복수 messages라서 were)
Once ~(~하자마자)는 시간 부사절 → 미래라도 현재시제 lands

en: Yesterday, [[Emily]] [[got]] [[a letter that her grandmother had written to her many years ago]], which made her cry happily.
me: a letter that her grandmother had written to her many years ago,
easy: that her grandmother had written to her many years ago
할머니가 여러 해 전에 그녀에게 써 주셨던(write 쓰다).
그것은 그녀가 행복하게 울게 만들었다(make 만들다, cry 울다).
요약: 할머니가 오래전 써 주신 편지를 받고 기쁨의 눈물을 흘렸다.
notes: 동사 cry(울다)를 꾸미는 말은 부사: happy(X) → happily(행복하게)
had written: 편지를 쓴 건 받은 때(yesterday)보다 훨씬 먼저 → 과거완료

en: [[They]] [[were]] in Asia for a month, and they came back home a couple of days ago, exhausted but excited.
me: and they came back home a couple of days ago,
easy: and they came back home a couple of days ago
며칠 전에 집에 돌아왔다(come back 돌아오다).
요약: 한 달 아시아에 있다가 며칠 전 지쳤지만 신나는 마음으로 돌아왔다.
notes: 감정 분사: 사람이 느끼면 -ed. 그들이 신난 거니까 exciting(X) → excited
but은 같은 모양끼리 잇는다: exhausted(-ed) but excited(-ed)

en: [[Many visitors]] [[have asked]] [[if the library will hold any special events soon]], but few of them were told the schedule.
me: if the library will hold any special events soon,
but few of them were told the schedule.
easy: if the library will hold any special events soon
도서관이 곧 특별 행사를 열지(hold 열다).
but few of them were told the schedule
하지만 그들 중 일정을 안내받은 사람은 거의 없었다(tell 말해 주다).
요약: 행사를 물어본 사람은 많은데 일정을 안내받은 사람은 드물었다.
notes: few / most / some + of + 명사가 주어면 of 뒤 명사에 동사를 맞춘다: of them(복수) → was(X) were
if ~가 ask의 목적어 = ~인지 (명사절) → 미래 will hold 그대로 OK

en: [[We]] [[have known]] [[each other]] for a long time, and now we are good friends who trust each other completely.
me: and now we are good friends who trust each other completely.
easy: and now we are good friends
요약: 오래 알아 온 만큼 이제는 서로를 믿는 좋은 친구다.
notes: who 뒤 동사는 선행사에 맞춘다: friends(복수) → trusts(X) trust
each other = 서로. 한 덩어리로 목적어 역할을 한다

en: [[He]] [[has had]] [[a fear of heights]] since he fell off a ladder when he was seven years old, an accident that frightened his whole family.
me: since he fell off a ladder when he was seven years old,
an accident that frightened his whole family.
easy: since he fell off a ladder when he was seven
일곱 살 때 사다리에서 떨어진 이래로(fall 떨어지다).
an accident that frightened his whole family
온 가족을 놀라게 한 사고(frighten 겁먹게 하다).
요약: 어릴 때 사다리에서 떨어진 뒤로 높은 곳이 무섭다.
notes: that 뒤에는 진짜 동사가 와야 한다. frightening(-ing)은 동사 자리에 못 온다 → 과거 사건이니 frightened(과거형)
동사 모양 vs 분사 모양: 문장에서 동사 자리인지 먼저 확인하기

en: [[I]] [[was]] [[alone]] in the deep mountains when I got a terrible stomachache, so I decided to call for help.
me: in the deep mountains when I got a terrible stomachache,
so I decided to call for help.
easy: when I got a terrible stomachache
so I decided to call for help
그래서 도움을 요청하기로 결심했다(decide 결심하다, call 부르다).
요약: 산속에서 배가 아파 도움을 부르기로 했다.
notes: decide + to부정사: decide to call(O) / decided calling(X). 예: want to, plan to, hope to도 to만
so는 앞 일의 결과를 이끈다: 복통 때문에 → 그래서 결심

en: As soon as the weather improves, [[the outdoor market]] [[will reopen]], which will excite all the local vendors.
me: As soon as the weather improves,
, which will excite all the local vendors.
easy: 야외 시장이 다시 열 것이다(reopen 다시 열다).
As soon as the weather improves
which will excite all the local vendors
모든 현지 상인들을 신나게 할 것이다(excite 신나게 하다).
요약: 날씨가 풀리면 시장이 열려 상인들이 신날 것이다.
notes: 아직 안 일어난 일은 will: 시장이 다시 열릴 미래 → 그 결과도 미래 excited(X) will excite
As soon as ~ 안에서는 미래라도 현재시제(improves)

en: [[Casey]] [[was chosen]] as the MVP because she had scored all three goals during the match, a performance more impressive than that of any other player.
me: because she had scored all three goals during the match,
a performance more impressive than that of any other player.
easy: Casey was chosen as the MVP
because she had scored all three goals
세 골을 모두 넣었기 때문에(score 득점하다).
a performance more impressive than that of any other player
다른 어떤 선수의 활약보다 더 인상적인 활약.
요약: 세 골을 넣은 Casey가 최고의 활약으로 MVP가 됐다.
notes: 비교는 같은 종류끼리: 활약(performance)과 비교할 것은 선수(player)가 아니라 '선수의 활약' → that of any other player
that은 앞에 나온 명사를 대신한다 (여기서 that = performance). 예: The weather here is better than that of Seoul.
